deploy-bot: staging deploy started by jen — env: staging, tag: release/v0.5.3-rc2, sha: ab12f9d, change window: 2026-03-20 02:00-03:00 UTC, affected services: runtime, orchestrator, reranker. Rolling canary 10%. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/staging-deploy

jen: Starting smoke now, will post updates. cc @kai @ada :eyes:

kai: watching logs for reranker, will take action if latency > 250ms on >5% requests

ada: if reranker degrades, pin to release/v0.5.2 and abort rollout. I can cut the pin if needed.

deploy-bot: canary 10% -> 30% (8/10 hosts healthy). Orchestrator health OK. Reranker: observed 503s on host-13 — `Error: OOM while decoding`. Isolating host-13 and draining traffic. /cc @sre-oncall

sre-oncall: investigating host-13. Looks like a bad quantization binary on that node, isolating and marking for rebuild.

ops: will exclude host-13 from the routing pool and trigger image rebuild.

jen: decision: continue rollout excluding host-13. If errors exceed 2% at any step we revert to v0.5.2. Proceeding. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: traffic excluded host-13. Canary -> 60%. No new 503s in the last 5m. Latency p95 stable at 190ms. Starting full traffic shift.

deploy-bot: deploy complete — release/v0.5.3-rc2 promoted to staging. Duration 12m34s. Commit: ab12f9d. Release notes draft: https://redwood.internal/notes/0.5.3-rc2. No pin required.

melissa: nice. can we add a short note about the quantization binary mismatch in the release notes?

ada: added the note and created a follow-up: INF-4321 (rebuild image for host-13 and add an extra assertion during quantize).

jen: thanks everyone — closing change window early.

jen: (command for pin if we had needed it)
```
redwood deploy pin --env staging --tag release/v0.5.2
```

deploy-bot: archived logs and artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/1718456789/staging. If anything looks off, reopen the thread.
